videos.title: It's a Mann's World
videos.description: Multitalented entertainers David and Tamela Mann are known mostly for their stage and screen collaborations with producer Tyler Perry ("Meet the Browns"). "It's a Mann's World" provides fans a view of the couple behind the camera -- at home, attending exclusive events, and spending time with famous friends. The hourlong episodes show how David and Tamela balance being celebrities, entrepreneurs and parents to four adult children while maintaining their marriage of 20-plus years.
